text: DSH Ox-Horse Office 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的多智能体会话可视化插件。它在浏览器界面加入像素风办公室面板，将当前会话和其他 agent 会话显示为牛马员工，并实时呈现工作、空闲和排队状态。用户可以查看员工活动摘要与工作流监控、从老板角色向当前会话发送指令，并处理待审批的工具调用。适合希望直观看到多个 DSH 会话运行情况并在办公室视图中进行轻量交互的用户。需要 DSH Web profile；代码未声明额外 API Key 或运行时外部服务。

DSH Ox-Horse Office adds a pixel-art dashboard to the DSH Web client, showing live sessions as workers with working, idle, and queued states. Inspect activity, view recent work, prompt the current session, and handle pending tool approvals. Requires a DSH Web profile; no extra API key is declared.
想把多个 DSH agent 的运行状态放在一个办公室里看。
有没有能显示哪些会话正在工作、哪些空闲的可视化面板？
让 DSH 用像素风场景展示子 agent 的活动和排队情况。
我想点开某个正在运行的工位，查看它最近的思考、输出和工具调用。
能不能在会话看板里直接给当前 agent 发一条指令？
DSH 有工具调用等我批准时，有没有醒目的提醒和就地审批入口？
I want a visual dashboard that shows which of my DSH sessions are busy, idle, or queued.
Can I inspect a running agent's recent work and approve its pending tool request from the same visual workspace?
DSH Ox-Horse Office 的功能「实时办公室」：面板把当前会话和其他会话绘制为办公室员工，并更新工作、空闲、员工总数及排队统计。点击员工可查看身份、状态和当前活动摘要。
DSH Ox-Horse Office 的功能「工位监控」：点击工作中员工的屏幕会打开该会话的工作流窗口，展示最近的思考、发言、工具调用和工具结果，并支持少量行内 Markdown 格式。
DSH Ox-Horse Office 的功能「老板指令」：点击老板角色打开迷你输入框，发送内容会通过当前会话的 prompt 队列提交；成功后输入框收起，失败时显示错误并保留草稿。
DSH Ox-Horse Office 的功能「待审批提醒」：有会话等待工具批准时，员工会定期举手提示；审批卡可就地批准或拒绝，问题与计划评审则提供跳转到原生面板的入口。

English | [简体中文](./README.zh.md)

DSH Ox-Horse Office is a Web UI plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-harness) that renders the live activity of your multi-agent sessions as a pixel-art office. Every agent session becomes an ox/horse worker with its own badge -- running agents type at their desks, idle ones wander and nap, and you are the boss, sitting in the corner office wearing a crown.
dsh-office-plugin README · DSH Ox-Horse Office：> 🌟 **If this project made you smile or helped you out, please give it a Star -- it really helps, thank you!**

dsh-office-plugin README · Cast：| Role | Who | Where | Looks |
|---|---|---|---|
| **The Boss** | You, the user | Private corner office (bottom-right) | Dark-brown suit coat, gold trim, glasses, golden crown |
| **The Supervisor** | The current session (the agent you are talking to) | Supervisor desk above the open office floor | Golden coat + orange foreman helmet |
| **Workers** | All other sessions (subagents included) | 4×4 desk grid | Randomly ox or horse; coat and accessories are stable per session id |
dsh-office-plugin README · Cast：The office holds up to 16 workers (supervisor included); overflowing running sessions show up as "queued" and take a seat as earlier ones finish.

dsh-office-plugin README · Live office activity：- **Working / slacking**: a running session types at its desk with a scrolling-code screen and a blue glow; an idle one just sits, and after a while falls asleep at the desk (Zzz bubbles).
- **Speech bubbles**: streaming output, tools in flight, and latest reports surface as short bubbles. When the supervisor receives your new instruction it shouts "老板发话了，都给我干起来！" ("The boss has spoken -- back to work, everyone!") and calls every wandering worker back to their desk.
- **Idle wandering**: idle workers get up for coffee in the pantry, the whiteboard in the meeting room, or the sofa in the lounge -- with a one-liner like "grab a coffee" when they arrive.
- **Dashboard**: live counts of total / working / idle / queued workers.

dsh-office-plugin README · Click interactions：- **Click a worker**: an info card with species, status, title (supervisor / worker), and what it is doing right now.
- **Click a working worker's screen**: opens the **work monitor** window streaming that agent's activity -- thinking, output, tool calls, and reports -- with inline markdown (bold / inline code) support.

dsh-office-plugin README · Click interactions：- **Click the boss**: opens a mini input bar to issue orders directly to the current session (the supervisor) over the same channel as the main chat input. On success the bar collapses and the supervisor immediately shouts the order out; on failure the error shows inline in red and your draft is kept for retry.

dsh-office-plugin README · The corner office and the boss's daily routine：The boss (you) has a private office: an executive desk, a monitor, a gold-trimmed high-back chair, a bookshelf, plants, and a rug. The boss mostly works, with regular slacking:

> ```
>
> Replace `<commit>` with the hash printed in the error. Note that the bare package name (`dsh-office-plugin: true`) does not work. To avoid the allowBuilds dance entirely, use the npm or tarball method above -- prebuilt artifacts, no on-install build.

dsh-office-plugin README · Uninstallation：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-office-plugin
```

Restart `dsh web`. If the office entry still shows up afterwards, also remove the `"dsh-office-plugin"` line from the `bundles` list in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` and restart again.

dsh-office-plugin README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build       # tsdown dual config: host half -> lib/index.js, browser half -> lib/client.js
pnpm run watch
pnpm run typecheck

This is a dsh "two-half" plugin:

- **Host half** (`src/index.ts`): exists only to appear in the host's cordis load table;
- **Browser half** (`src/client/`): discovered via the `dsh.client` declaration in `package.json`, served by the loader as a single file at `/plugins/<id>/client.js`.

dsh-office-plugin README · Development：- `client.js` must be a single-file CJS bundle wrapped in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` banner (`inlineDynamicImports: true` -- pixi.js has dynamic imports that would otherwise split chunks and 404);
- the external list in `tsdown.config.ts` must track `PLATFORM_MODULES` from `packages/client/web/src/platform.ts` in the dsh repo, and `src/client/runtimeTypes.ts` is a hand-aligned local type face of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`.
